note: 花园唱片收藏者；熟络但不过分亲昵，集齐时兴奋。 专名保留英文；不硬塞网络梗。颜色采用服务器原始样本。

lines.context: Vinyl Collector：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: Hey man, I just need one more vinyl to complete the full Pest Vinyl collection.
lines.zh: 嘿，我还差一张唱片，就能凑齐整套害虫唱片了。
lines.raw: §fHey man, I just need one more vinyl to complete the full Pest Vinyl collection.

lines.context: Vinyl Collector：实测台词，Wiki 核对身份与对话阶段
lines.text: Finally! Thanks man, now I have another complete set!
lines.zh: 终于凑齐了! 谢谢你，我又集齐了一套!
lines.raw: §fFinally! Thanks man, now I have another complete set!
